Token counts were unavailable from Agent completion notifications and are not estimated from output characters.

The fixture mirrors the production skill command and receipt contract without creating real sessions. Production wrapper and receipt behavior are independently covered by the full CCS suite, including fake-CMUX_BIN end-to-end tests.
The first parallel attempt was discarded because sibling agents inherited one CLAUDE_SESSION_ID and collided in prompt staging. Reported runs use unique synthetic IDs.
Agent wall time includes skill reading, tool orchestration, artifact writing, and fixture execution. It is not launcher latency.
